title: g8e Model Context Protocol (MCP) Schema
description: JSON Schema for the Model Context Protocol (MCP) as implemented by the g8e Gateway. This schema defines the JSON-RPC 2.0 messages supported for tool execution, resource access, and prompt management, including g8e-specific extensions like A2A skill calls. The gateway accepts notifications/initialized and notifications/* methods, returning HTTP 202 Accepted with no response body. JSON-RPC batch requests (arrays) are rejected with error code -32600. The unified /mcp endpoint also supports GET for SSE streaming (server-sent events with 30-second heartbeat keepalives). Tool calls and A2A calls that require L3 (WebAuthn) authorization are suspended and returned with an approval URL; the client must complete out-of-band approval before the transaction resumes.

id.description: The request identifier. May be null when the server cannot parse the request enough to extract an id (e.g. parse errors).

method.description: The JSON-RPC method name. Supported methods: initialize, ping, tools/list, tools/call, resources/list, resources/read, resources/templates/list, prompts/list, prompts/get, a2a/call, notifications/initialized, notifications/*.

params.description: The parameters for the method. Accepts any valid JSON value (object, array, string, number, boolean, or null). Most methods expect an object; tools/call arguments may be any JSON value.

InitializeRequest.description: The first request sent by the client to negotiate protocol version and capabilities. The g8e Gateway echoes the client's protocolVersion if provided; otherwise defaults to 2025-06-18.

protocolVersion.description: The version of the MCP protocol the client wants to use.

InitializeParams.description: The subset of initialize params negotiated by the g8e gateway. Only protocolVersion is parsed from the incoming params.

protocolVersion.description: The version of the MCP protocol the client wants to use.

InitializeResult.description: The server's response to an initialize request. The gateway echoes the client's requested protocolVersion, or defaults to 2025-06-18. Server info is name='g8e-gateway', version='1.0'. Note: serverInfo.version is the MCP server implementation version (mcpServerVersion constant), intentionally separate from the g8e platform version (currently v1.5.0).

protocolVersion.description: The version of the MCP protocol the server selected.

instructions.description: Instructions for the client on how to use the server.

ServerCapabilities.description: Capabilities supported by the g8e Gateway server. All three capability objects (tools, resources, prompts) are always present in the initialize response.

ToolsCapability.description: Tools capability configuration. listChanged is always true on the g8e Gateway.

ResourcesCapability.description: Resources capability configuration. The g8e Gateway exposes this as an empty object.

PromptsCapability.description: Prompts capability configuration. The g8e Gateway exposes this as an empty object.

ClientCapabilities.description: Capabilities supported by the MCP client. The g8e Gateway accepts any client capabilities object.

ListToolsResult.description: The result of a tools/list request. When no downstream MCP server is configured, returns native tools compiled into the Operator. When a downstream is configured, the gateway proxies tools/list to the downstream server and returns the raw response.

Tool.description: Definition of a tool that can be called by the client.

name.description: The unique name of the tool. Must be lowercase alphanumeric with underscores.

description.description: A human-readable description of the tool.

InputSchema.description: JSON Schema for tool input validation. The type field must be 'object'. Properties and required are always present (may be empty).

properties.description: Map of property names to their schema definitions.

CallToolRequest.description: Arguments for a tools/call request. If arguments is omitted or empty, it defaults to an empty object '{}'.

name.description: The name of the tool to call.

arguments.description: The arguments to pass to the tool, matching its inputSchema. Accepts any valid JSON value (object, array, string, number, boolean, or null). Defaults to '{}' if omitted.

CallToolResult.description: The result of a tool execution. When a tool call is suspended for L3 (WebAuthn) authorization, the content contains a text block with an approval URL and instructions. isError is true when the operator reports a non-completed execution status.

isError.description: True if the tool execution failed.

TextContent.description: A text-based content block in a tool response or message.

ListResourcesResult.description: The result of a resources/list request. Returns an empty array when no downstream MCP server is configured.

Resource.description: A resource provided by the server.

uri.description: The unique URI of the resource.

Metadata.description: Typed metadata for MCP resources and prompts.

uri.description: The URI of the resource to read.

ReadResourceResult.description: The result of a resources/read request. The contents array contains a single TextContent with the resource summary. mimeType is omitted when not applicable.

ListPromptsResult.description: The result of a prompts/list request. Returns an empty array when no downstream MCP server is configured.

Prompt.description: A prompt template provided by the server.

GetPromptRequest.description: Parameters for the prompts/get method. Arguments is a map of string key-value pairs for prompt template substitution.

name.description: The name of the prompt to get.

arguments.description: Arguments to fill in the prompt template.

PromptArgument.description: An argument for a prompt template.

GetPromptResult.description: The result of a prompts/get request. Both description and messages are optional (omitempty in Go). When the operator returns a non-completed status, the description is prefixed with 'Error: '.

PromptMessage.description: A message in a prompt template response. The g8e Gateway uses role='user' for the single message it returns.

JSONRPCError.description: A JSON-RPC 2.0 error object. Standard JSON-RPC error codes (-32700, -32600, -32601, -32603) are used for protocol-level errors. g8e-specific error codes (-32000 to -32101) are used for governance verification failures.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code. Standard codes: -32700 (parse error), -32600 (invalid request), -32601 (method not found), -32603 (internal error). g8e governance codes: -32000 (invalid envelope), -32001 (hash mismatch), -32002 (expired), -32003 (replay), -32004 (state root mismatch), -32005 (L1 validation failed), -32006 (L2 signature invalid), -32007 (L3 proof invalid), -32008 (payload decode failed), -32100 (resource not found), -32101 (gateway not ready).

data.description: Additional error data. Accepts any valid JSON value.

JSONRPCResponse.description: A JSON-RPC 2.0 response object. The gateway returns HTTP 200 for both success and error responses. Either result or error is present, never both. id may be null when the server could not parse the request to extract an id.

result.description: The result payload. Accepts any valid JSON value whose shape depends on the method.

id.description: The request identifier, matching the request. May be null for parse errors.

PingRequest.description: A ping request to check server liveness. No params are required.

PingResult.description: The result of a ping request. Returns an empty object {}.

ResourceTemplate.description: An MCP resource template with a URI pattern.

uriTemplate.description: The URI template pattern for the resource.

name.description: The name of the resource template.

ListResourceTemplatesResult.description: The result of a resources/templates/list request. The g8e Gateway returns an empty array as no resource templates are exposed.

NotificationAccepted.description: The gateway accepts notifications/initialized and notifications/* methods, returning HTTP 202 Accepted with no JSON-RPC response body. Notifications carry no result or error payload. The 'initialized' method (without notifications/ prefix) is also accepted as a notification.

A2ACallRequest.description: Arguments for an a2a/call request (g8e extension). If payload is omitted or empty, it defaults to '{}'. The skill is executed through the same governance pipeline as tools/call.

skill_name.description: The name of the A2A skill to call.

payload.description: The payload to pass to the A2A skill. Accepts any valid JSON value. Defaults to '{}' if omitted or empty.

A2ACallResult.description: The result of an A2A skill execution. Returns A2ASuspensionResponse when L3 (WebAuthn) authorization is required, or A2ASuccessResponse on completion.

A2ASuccessResponse.description: Successful A2A skill execution response. The result field contains a serialized operator ActionReceipt protobuf message.

result.description: The action receipt from the operator (protobuf type). Contains transaction_id, status, and result_summary fields.

A2ADownstreamRequest.description: Request sent to a downstream A2A server. Same structure as A2ACallRequest.

payload.description: The payload to send to the downstream A2A server. Accepts any valid JSON value.

A2ASuspensionResponse.description: A2A skill execution suspended for L3 (WebAuthn) authorization. The client should direct the user to the approval_url to complete out-of-band authorization. The transaction resumes automatically once the proof is verified.

tx_hash.description: The transaction hash, same value as id.

approval_url.description: URL where the user can complete WebAuthn approval.

message.description: Human-readable instructions containing the approval URL.
